pagination.meaning: Offset counts distinct alternatives, excluding the reserved baseline. Keep the brief and catalog fixed between pages; changing either starts a new exploration.

query_interpretation.name_lookup_advice: query ranks preferences and can return alternatives when a name is absent. Use family for a hard exact family-name lookup.
query_interpretation.unmodeled_terms_meaning: Terms not interpreted by deterministic aliases; only literal name matching can use them without a visual adapter.
query_interpretation.negation_scope: Query and tone are interpreted independently. Negation extends across comma-coordinated terms until a sentence/semicolon/colon boundary, an explicit contrast such as but, or a comma-led positive clause such as prefer or use. Check the reported polarity for ambiguous prose.
query_interpretation.method: Negation-aware aliases, literal name matches, measured context preferences, and optional content-based visual evidence. Unmodeled terms are not interpreted by metadata ranking; a visual adapter may interpret them. unrecognized brief fields have no effect.

refinement.method: Content-based visual evidence when supplied for a face; otherwise proximity in at least two measured proportions. Reference IDs remain eligible unless excluded.

context_interpretation.advice: Use the actual language, size, text, hierarchy and surrounding design in a contextual composition. Context fields guide preferences; none proves aesthetic fit.

constraints.coverage: Requested non-layout characters must occur in cmap; this does not prove shaping correctness.
constraints.family_diversity: At most one face per family; equivalent canonical content is also deduplicated. Equal-score ties favor differences in known category, width, monospace measurement, x-height, and advance-width bands; this is not proof of visual distinction.

alternatives.advice: Compare a single family's observed styles before adding a second typeface; additional fonts are not inherently an improvement.
Keeping the current typography is a valid outcome. Supply existing_id to include an exact catalog face as the comparison baseline.

limitations: Rankings combine explicitly labeled evidence. Visual adapter scores are interpretations, not quality or readability measurements; missing visual evidence remains eligible.
Render the selected exact faces on project text at intended sizes. Coverage alone cannot establish legibility, shaping, personality, or good pairing.
Metadata categories and family groupings may be imperfect. Available styles describe this collection, not a complete upstream family.
Unknown rights remain unknown. Embedded open-license evidence is not legal clearance; review source and license evidence before distribution.
